title: Derived square for termwise finite free pullback
statement: Let T, X, Z, f, W, A, B, α, eA and eB be a specified bounded-above finite-free chart model as in the following sense: X,Z are derived objects [def-pc-derived-category] on a scheme T [def-pc-scheme]; A,B are bounded-above cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] on W with finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module]; eA:L(W.ι)*X≅Q(A) and eB:L(W.ι)*Z≅Q(B) identify L(W.ι)*(f) with Q(α) [def-pc-derived-pullback], but without choosing a cohomological degree. For g:T′→T put V=g⁻¹(W), and F=tensorPullback(g|_V) followed by the inverse module-site equivalence [def-pc-module-pullback]. Given additivity of F, put P=F(A), Q=F(B), β=F(α). Let R be exact restriction to the localized site over V. In its standard derived category there exist isomorphisms dP:Rᴰ(Lg*X)≅Q(P), dQ:Rᴰ(Lg*Z)≅Q(Q), satisfying Rᴰ(Lg*f)≫dQ.hom=dP.hom≫Q(β). This statement asserts the geometric comparison before applying any homology functor.

proof.text: For each term of A and B, use the supplied finite-free isomorphism. The structure sheaf is flat because tensoring with the tensor unit is an equivalence. A free sheaf is the coproduct of copies of this unit, so lem-pc-sites-modules-coproduct-flat and invariance of exactness under natural isomorphism make each term flat. Apply lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat to both bounded-above complexes. Use the adopted source theorem CochainComplex.isKFlat_of_boundedAbove_flat_ringedSpace, whose conclusion is IsKFlatTensor, matching the current derivedPullback_spec.

Unpack the specification of the chosen derivedPullback h from def-pc-derived-pullback, identifying its underived functor with tensorPullback h by its object and map equalities. This yields one natural counit epsilon, invertible at every K-flat complex. Whisker epsilon with the homotopy quotient and the standard quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors comparisons to obtain a natural transformation eta from Q followed by Lh* to termwise tensor pullback followed by Q. Postcompose with the exact inverse module-site equivalence, using mapDerivedCategoryFactors and mapHomologicalComplexCompIso, to obtain psi. Its components at A and B are invertible by step 1. Prove invertibility of the eta and psi components using their explicit isomorphism factors, without normalizing the concrete module functors. Retain these transformations and the constructed unit, restriction and composition isomorphisms behind their typed interfaces; all witnesses are the ones just constructed.

For an open U of X, the tensor-pullback adjunction and the exact restriction adjunction identify tensorPullback U.ι with overFunctor followed by overEquiv.functor. Exact restriction has an invertible localization factorization; the universal property of a left-derived functor therefore identifies its mapDerivedCategory naturally with derivedPullback U.ι. Apply this to V in T prime. The derived module-site equivalence and its unit then identify R.mapDerivedCategory with L(V.ι)* followed by overEquiv.inverse.mapDerivedCategory. Compose the two comparisons supplied by lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition and the identity h followed by W.ι equals V.ι followed by g to obtain a natural isomorphism d from Lg* followed by R.mapDerivedCategory to L(W.ι)* followed by Lh* followed by overEquiv.inverse.mapDerivedCategory. Use perfectHomComposition from lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport for these two comparisons, rather than eliminating the full composition existence predicate inside the proof.

Put L = Lh* followed by overEquiv.inverse.mapDerivedCategory. Define eP = d.app X followed by L.mapIso eA followed by asIso (psi.app A), and define eQ with Z and B. Naturality of d rewrites the left-hand side of the desired square. Functoriality of L and hsquare replace L.map (L(W.ι)* f followed by eB.hom) by L.map (eA.hom followed by Q.map alpha). Naturality of psi at alpha gives exactly the required right-hand side. This is a direct associativity calculation and changes no object or localization instance.

Use the already constructed singleComplexOpenPullbackIso for exact open restriction, rather than repeating its left-derived uniqueness construction privately. Introduce the statement's fixed functors and complexes directly. Transport the underived over-site equivalence unit using mapDerivedCategoryIdIso, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso; only this unit isomorphism is needed, so constructing an adjointified derived equivalence is unnecessary. The remaining counit/naturality calculation is unchanged. The concrete over-site equivalence is stored in a private irreducible construction equal to Modules.overEquiv; transport the termwise composite and open-restriction functor through that proved equality before taking their complex and derived comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem bottomFreeChain_derived_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (X Z : schemeDerivedCategory T) (f : X ⟶ Z)
    (W : T.Opens)
    (A B : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hAbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (A.X i))
    (hBbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (B.X i))
    (hAfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (A.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (hBfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (B.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (α : A ⟶ B)
    (eA : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj X ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj A)
    (eB : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj Z ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)
    (hsquare : (derivedPullback W.ι).map f ≫ eB.hom =
      eA.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map α)
    (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    let V := g ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let F := Modules.tensorPullback (g.resLE W V (le_refl V)) ⋙
      (Modules.overEquiv V).inverse
    ∀ hF : F.Additive,
      letI := hF
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace).over V))
      let R := SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace) V
      let P := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj A
      let Q := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj B
      let β := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map α
      ∃ (eP : R.mapDerivedCategory.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj X) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
        (eQ : R.mapDerivedCategory.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj Z) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q),
        R.mapDerivedCategory.map ((derivedPullback g).map f) ≫ eQ.hom =
          eP.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map β
